Welcome to CAPS!

Dear {{1.firstname}},

We are delighted to welcome you to the Cape Animal Protection Shelter Inc. (CAPS) volunteer team!

Your application has been reviewed and approved. You are now a registered CAPS volunteer.

We will be in touch shortly with more information about the next steps on how you can get started with your volunteer activities.

If you have any questions in the meantime, please don't hesitate to contact us at info@capeanimalprotectionshelter.org.au

Thank you for giving your time to help the animals in our care.

Warm regards,
The CAPS Team
Cape Animal Protection Shelter Inc.
Weipa, Queensland
